subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers clear the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh Feishu target-resolution repair, or revive that PR as the canonical fix candidate?
rationale: The issue is still valid enough to keep open, but an open fork PR has closing syntax, conflicts, and no proof, while the same-repo predecessor was closed unmerged; automation should not create a competing fix until that candidate is resolved.

options.title: Clear candidate and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or mark the conflicting fork PR as superseded, then let a narrow Feishu plugin repair handle target validation, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork author or a maintainer to rebase, address the prior type/review defect, and add real Feishu proof before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Wait for live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a maintainer or reporter can provide a redacted live Feishu send transcript that distinguishes target validation from tenant/vendor setup.

recommendation.title: Clear candidate and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or mark the conflicting fork PR as superseded, then let a narrow Feishu plugin repair handle target validation, tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community-maintenance contact, so they are the best available owner for the plugin-specific routing choice.
